The original version of this field called this loop the flush window's clearest ceremony mismatch on the grounds that it was a pure docs-only file move; that premise was false. Commit c68cdc4 also changed `scripts/sync-test-run-completion.mjs`, its two test files, and `.github/workflows/test-run-completion.yml` — runtime code and a live workflow trigger, not documentation. So round 2 was legitimate. Only round 3 — a second consecutive clean pass with nothing between it and round 2 — is unsupported by the consequence rule.
